name: fixture: the main menu stays open after a click outside it
about: The flow's own fixture app (demo/flow/fixture): a planted bug of the same kind as excalidraw #12053, for runs against the mock. No third-party code.
issue:
The main menu does not close when I click outside it.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the app.
2. Click the menu button (the three lines at the top left).
3. Click anywhere on the empty canvas.

Expected: the menu closes.
Actual: the menu stays open until you press its button again.

answer_key.about: The planted bug: src/menu.js listens for presses outside the menu on the menu itself, so they never arrive.

safety.message: A scripted check from the mock, to show the acknowledgement path.

answer.summary: I opened the main menu and clicked the empty canvas; the menu is still open.
I opened the main menu and clicked the empty canvas; the menu closed.

plan.summary: Close the menu on a press anywhere outside it: the outside-press listener is attached to the menu itself, so presses outside never reach it.
steps: Attach the pointerdown listener to the document instead of the menu root

edits.reason: The outside-press listener is on the menu, not the document

tests.what: a press outside the menu closes it

rounds.explanation: src/menu.js:17 attaches the outside-press listener to the menu root, so a press on the canvas never reaches it; listening on the document lets src/menu.js:18 see presses outside the menu and close it.
